The '''Outer Moon''' was one of the two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prakith/Legends|Prakith]]. During the early years of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], it was the site of the [[Imperial Testing Grounds]], a facility that was used develop new [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designs.
